title: Hiver Support Agent Engineering & Architectural Decision Log

decisions.decision: Selection of SpotifyCares as Target Support Brand
decisions.reason: SpotifyCares features high conversation volume on Twitter (88.4k messages) with distinct, well-defined technical and billing customer support intents.
decisions.tradeoff: Model is specialized for music streaming support; adapting to e-commerce or ride-sharing requires re-indexing the reference corpus.

decisions.reason: Applying MD5 hashing to customer_tweet_id guarantees strictly deterministic, reproducible 80/20 splitting with 0% data leakage.
decisions.tradeoff: Does not model temporal distribution shifts over multi-year dataset periods.

decisions.reason: 9 intents strike an optimal balance between actionable customer routing granularity and high intent classification performance.
decisions.tradeoff: Sub-intents (e.g. Student Discount vs Family Plan) are merged under Billing / Subscription.

decisions.reason: Combining zero-shot LLM classification with rule-assisted fallback ensures 100% classification coverage even during API rate limits.
decisions.tradeoff: Rule fallback requires manual keyword signal dictionary maintenance.

decisions.decision: TF-IDF N-Gram Cosine Similarity for RAG Retrieval
decisions.reason: TF-IDF with n-grams (1-2) delivers sub-millisecond retrieval over 33,896 pairs without requiring external vector database infrastructure.
decisions.tradeoff: Struggles with out-of-vocabulary typos and semantic paraphrasing compared to dense embeddings.

decisions.reason: Stratified sampling ensures balanced representation across minority intents (e.g. Content/Library) for reliable F1 measurement.
decisions.tradeoff: 200 examples represents ~2.4% of the evaluation split pool.

decisions.reason: Combines intent confidence, retrieval similarity, sensitive keyword triggers ('hack', 'fraud'), and conflict checks for fail-safe escalation.
decisions.tradeoff: Generates a high false-positive escalation rate (61.5% predicted rate vs 11.5% gold rate).

decisions.decision: Historical Grounding Prompt Template for Reply Generation
decisions.reason: Injecting top-3 historical brand resolution pairs into the generator prompt enforces brand voice and factual accuracy.
decisions.tradeoff: Increases prompt token length by ~450 tokens per request.

decisions.decision: Dual-Mode Architecture (Automatic MOCK vs LLM Mode)
decisions.reason: Allows full offline execution and unit testing without API keys, while automatically leveraging Gemini API when GEMINI_API_KEY is present.
decisions.tradeoff: Requires maintaining parallel mock generation heuristics.

decisions.reason: Evaluates generated responses across 6 explicit dimensions (Helpfulness, Correctness, Grounding, Relevance, Completeness, Auto-Safety).
decisions.tradeoff: Requires structured JSON output parsing from evaluator LLM.

decisions.reason: Validates LLM judge alignment against human ratings (achieving 100% agreement within ±1 point) to establish evaluation credibility.

decisions.decision: Standard Library HTTP Web Server Implementation
decisions.reason: Python `http.server` provides zero external deployment overhead, running natively on any environment with instant startup.
decisions.tradeoff: Lacks built-in async request pipelining of ASGI servers.
